## Checklist

- [ ] The skill is in its own folder: `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`
- [ ] The `name` in the frontmatter matches the folder name
- [ ] The `description` starts with "Use when…" and uses words people actually say
- [ ] Anything specific to one business is in a **Your setup** block with `<PLACEHOLDERS>`
- [ ] It follows the five rules (approve first, never guess, keep history, leave a trail, print-friendly)
- [ ] All sample data is fake: no real names, phone numbers, emails or company records
- [ ] I've tried it in Claude at least once
- [ ] I've added a row to the skills table in `README.md`
